Financial assistance of Rs 61,000 to the Guardian of Girl Child in different stages up to the age of 18 years.
Families with an annual income of less than ₹30,000 qualify for the scheme.
The scheme is a significant initiative aimed at preventing female foeticide and promoting the education and welfare of girl children.
The parents of the girl child must be permanent residents of Punjab.
It provides financial assistance to eligible families at different stages to reduce the financial burden associated with the birth and upbringing of a girl child.
